Agency.description:
Identifies the lead agency (e.g., EPA, State) conducting the inspection. 
Values: State abbreviation or "EPA"

DataVerification.description:
The sanitary source survey conclusion for data verification operations. Applicable codes: 
- M - Minor Deficiencies
- N - No Deficiencies or Recommendations
- R - Recommendations Made
- S - Significant Deficiencies
- X - Not Evaluated
- Z - Not Applicable
- (blank) - Not Reported to EPA
